resolution.note: fix(slice): save the review record with the pending flag cleared (t-4bc72d3)

title: slice run saves the review record with the pending flag cleared
body:
Outcome: `krn slice run` keeps `reviewPending` set until the review record and attempt count are saved in the same journal write, so a crash between the review returning and that write fails closed instead of allowing another attempt.
Evidence: PR #203 review 2 NON_BLOCKING (record .krn/runs/review-series/2c61c362c41220e80ad6f96a996524ba33468f8cb12dce620311f552420412d5/records/2.json), src/slice/run.ts reviewPending=false saved before record parse.
Proof: a crash injected after review returns a record leaves the rerun refusing with 65 and no review call.
